name: Cultist: Empire Commander raises every primary stat by 4/8/12% per rank (#1350)
contract: All three ranks have a single effect, Apply Aura SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE (137), EffectMiscValue -1 (the documented 'all stats' sentinel). EffectBasePoints are 3, 7, 11 with DieSides 1, giving +4%, +8%, +12% respectively - an exact per-rank match to the tooltip. AuraEffect::HandleModTotalPercentStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp ~4510-4535) loops STAT_STRENGTH..MAX_STATS for MiscValue == -1, multiplies every stat's TOTAL_PCT modifier by GetTotalAuraMultiplier over all matching SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE auras, and calls UpdateStatBuffMod so the change is visible immediately. The stat metric reads Unit::GetStat directly, so learning a rank must raise every stat's reading by the matching ratio over the same character's own unbuffed baseline - no injected test stats needed, since the aura is a pure percentage of whatever Strength the fixture already has. Each rank is unlearned before the next is learned so the ranks are never stacked; a final unlearn-all step restores the original ratio of 1.0, confirming cleanup. Numbers read from Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer; the -1 sentinel was independently confirmed against the consumer code, not assumed. No script or SQL references 704887, 707781 or 712470. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.

steps.label: Removing every rank restores the original Strength (cleanup)
